description: Scaffold the monorepo structure with pnpm workspaces, configure Next.js 15 (App Router) frontend, NestJS backend, shared packages, Prisma ORM with full database schema, and all tooling (ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript).
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspaces config pointing to apps/* and packages/*

Scaffold apps/web as Next.js 15 App Router project with TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4, and the following dependencies: next@15, react@19, typescript, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, framer-motion, zustand, @tanstack/react-query, react-hook-form, zod, next-auth, lucide-react, recharts, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority
Configure apps/web/tailwind.config.ts with the Karya Kreatif Andalan color palette: emerald green (#10B981, #059669), dark navy (#1E293B, #0F172A), white, soft gray (#F8FAFC, #F1F5F9)

Initialize shadcn/ui in apps/web with the custom theme colors and install these components: button, card, input, label, select, dialog, dropdown-menu, sheet, tabs, badge, avatar, separator, skeleton, toast, form, table, calendar, command, popover

Scaffold apps/api as NestJS project with TypeScript and these dependencies: @nestjs/core, @nestjs/common, @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/config, @nestjs/jwt, @nestjs/passport, @nestjs/swagger, @prisma/client, prisma, passport, passport-jwt, passport-local, bcryptjs, class-validator, class-transformer, multer, uuid, dayjs

Create apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma with full database schema including all entities: User, Role, UserRole, Vehicle, VehicleCategory, VehicleImage, Booking, BookingStatus, Payment, Invoice, Penalty, MaintenanceLog, VehicleCheckpoint, CheckpointImage, Document, DriverVerification, Promo, PromoUsage, Notification, SupportTicket, TicketMessage, AuditLog, BlogPost, FAQ, Banner, Referral. Use SQLite as dev datasource with proper relations, enums, indexes, and timestamps.
Create packages/shared with shared Zod validation schemas (auth, booking, vehicle, payment) and TypeScript types/interfaces that both apps can import
Add root-level scripts: build, dev, lint, test, format, db:generate, db:migrate, db:seed

Create apps/api/prisma/seed.ts with comprehensive seed data: 5 user roles, sample users for each role, 3 vehicle categories (sedan, MPV, electric motorcycle), 10 sample vehicles with realistic data for Indonesian ride-hailing market, sample bookings, and promo codes
Verify: pnpm install succeeds, pnpm run build succeeds for both apps, prisma generate works
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install completes without errors from root
pnpm run build compiles both apps/web and apps/api successfully
Prisma schema is valid (npx prisma validate passes)
npx prisma generate creates the Prisma client
TypeScript compilation succeeds with strict mode in both apps
Shared package can be imported by both apps
Seed script runs without errors against SQLite
findings: Used TailwindCSS v3 with CSS variable-based color system for shadcn/ui compatibility. The pnpm onlyBuiltDependencies config was needed to allow prisma/sharp/nestjs build scripts. SQLite DB file is properly gitignored. tailwindcss-animate plugin added for shadcn animation support. Next.js ESLint config set up with next/core-web-vitals.
